Question: Suppose \([a\ b]\) denotes the average of \(a\) and \(b,\) and \(\{a\ b\ c\}\) denotes the average of \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c.\) What is the value of the following expression? \[\{\{1 \ 1 \ 0\} \ [0 \ 1] \ 0\}\]
